cohort_total_n_excerpt: This prospective observational analysis included 3771 women and 2771 men who participated in the Supplémentation en Vitamines et Minéraux Antioxydants study (1994-2007) and completed at least 6 valid 24-h dietary records during the first 2 y of follow-up.
reason: The prospective analysis reports incident prostate cancer but does not distinguish aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal disease.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In stratified analyses (by sex-specific median of dietary fiber intake), alcohol intake was directly associated with hormone-dependent cancer (tertile 3 vs. tertile 1: HR: 1.76; 95% CI: 1.10, 2.82; P-trend = 0.002), breast cancer (HR: 2.53; 95% CI: 1.30, 4.95; P-trend = 0.02), and prostate cancer (HR: 1.37; 95% CI: 0.65, 2.89; P-trend = 0.02) risk among individuals with low dietary fiber intake but not among their counterparts with higher dietary fiber intake (P-trend = 0.9, 0.8, and 0.6, respectively).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is for incident prostate cancer overall among participants with low dietary fiber intake; no aggressive subtype is specified.
